incident_log.summary: Idempotency check used a prefix with an exact-match API, causing 7 duplicate pilot jobs and 35 wasted credits.
incident_log.root_cause: hyp3_sdk HyP3.find_jobs(name=...) performs an exact name match. The check passed 'delhi_ncr_sbas_a27_v1_pilot', which matched 0 jobs even after 7 were submitted.
incident_log.fix: List multi-burst jobs and match exact names locally; never pass name= to find_jobs.
incident_log.tests_added: tests/test_pilot_idempotency.py (8 tests, incl. a guard that find_existing never passes name=)
incident_log.verified: A third --submit run submitted 0 jobs and credits remained at 7930.
incident_log.production_risk_mitigated: At production scale (336 jobs) the same bug would have wasted 1680 credits.
